name: faida-mcp
description: Kenya capital markets tools: Treasury bond calculator, NSE equities guide, unit trust comparison, diaspora investment, IPOs, financial literacy

tools.name: treasury_bond_calculator
tools.description: Estimate the gross coupon income and total return of a Kenyan Treasury bond from a principal, tenor and optional coupon. Use when someone asks roughly what a bond would pay. Interest is shown BEFORE the 15% withholding tax noted in the output, and the real-return estimate subtracts a fixed illustrative 6.5% inflation, not current inflation. coupon_rate_pct, including 0, is used as given; if omitted a sample-table rate is used for 2, 5, 10, 15 or 20 years and any other tenor gets a generic 14.5%, which rate_basis states. Returns the principal, tenor, rate, rate_basis, annual and total interest, total return, real return estimate, how to buy, the KES 50,000 minimum and tax. Indicative rates labelled DEMO: verify current yields at cbk.go.ke. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: nse_equities_guide
tools.description: How to buy and hold shares on the Nairobi Securities Exchange: opening a CDS account, buying, indices, market segments, main sectors, costs and diaspora access. Use when someone asks how investing in Kenyan equities works. Keywords in query select entries; if none match, ALL entries are returned; with no query it returns the full guide. Returns the source label, the information and the NSE portal. Fees and platforms are labelled DEMO and change: confirm with a licensed stockbroker. Not investment advice. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: unit_trust_comparison
tools.description: Compare Kenyan unit trust types (money market, bond, balanced, equity) by risk, typical return, liquidity, minimum investment and example funds. Use when someone asks which kind of fund suits their risk appetite. risk_profile selects the matching types; an unrecognised profile returns ALL types. Returns the source label, risk_profile, the funds, the regulator note and a tax note. Returns are indicative ranges labelled DEMO, not forecasts or recommendations: read each fund's factsheet. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: diaspora_investment_guide
tools.description: Ways Kenyans abroad can invest at home: M-Akiba bonds, NSE shares, unit trusts, REITs and property, with minimums and platforms, plus remittance and CDS-account tips. Use when a diaspora investor asks where to start. location is only echoed back; the same options are returned for everyone. Returns the source label, the echoed location, options, a remittance tip and the CDS pointer. Indicative yields labelled DEMO: verify with CBK, NSE and your adviser. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: nse_ipo_guide
tools.description: How to take part in a Kenyan IPO: the steps from watching NSE announcements to share allocation, typical minimum allocations and the state of the IPO market. Use when someone asks how to apply for shares in a new listing. Takes no arguments. Returns the source label, numbered steps, a recent-history note, the minimum allocation and a tip. Static summary labelled DEMO: each IPO's prospectus sets its own terms. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: financial_literacy_kenya
tools.description: Plain-language money guidance for Kenya: emergency fund, paying debt first, compound interest, diversification, M-PESA-linked savings, SACCO versus bank and a 50/30/20 budget. Use when someone asks how to start saving or investing. Keywords in topic select entries; if none match, ALL topics are returned; with no topic it returns the topic list. Returns the source label, the topic and the guidance. Example rates are indicative and labelled DEMO, and this is general education, not financial advice. Read-only; no side effects.
